Application of percentage

**∴ By 10.7% the number of coins that Chetan has is less than the number of coins that Avinash has.**

questions.question: A man walking at a speed of 3km/h crosses a square field diagonally in 5 minutes. What is the area of the field (in m²) ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Man walks 3 km/h

He takes 5 mins to cross the square field diagonally.

**Concept used:**

If A is the side of the measure of each side of a square, then A² is the area and A√2 is the measure of its diagonal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fc8beff634a6beaec0ea2cb01edf5c24a702725da5d7596a3ce6e54c15193e2.png] 

**Solution:**

Man travels in 5 mins = 3 × (5/60) = 1/4 km = 250m

So, the length of the diagonal of the square field = 250m

Let the measure of each side of the square field be L.

According to the question,

L√2 = 250

⇒ L = 125√2

⇒ L² = 31250

**∴ The area of the square field is 31250m²**.

questions.question: Atul borrowed a sum of Rs. 12000 and agreed to repay it by paying Rs. 4800 at the end of first year and Rs. 9240 at the end of second year. What is the rate of compound interest compounded annually?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal amount = Rs. 12000

Repayment at the end of the first year = Rs. 4800

Repayment at the end of the second year = Rs. 9240

**Concept used:**

A = P × (1 + r/100)n

C.I = A - P

Here, A = Amount, P = Principal, r = Rate of interest. n = Time, C.I = Compound interest

(A + B)² = A² + B² + 2AB

**Calculation:**

Let the rate of interest be R%.

The principal amount becomes after two years at a rate of R%

⇒ 12000 × (1 + R/100)²

Rs. 4800 is paid at the end of the first year. So, interest has to be counted on Rs. 4800 for one year only.

According to the question,

12000 × (1 + R/100)2 = 4800 + {(4800 × R × 1)/100} + 9240

⇒ 12000 × (1 + R/100)2 = 14040 + 48R

⇒ R = 10

**∴ The rate of compound interest is 10%.**

questions.question: A shop keeper sold an article at four-fifth of the marked price and suffered a loss of 3 (1)/(3)%. Find the profit percent, if he sold the article at the marked price. (correct to nearest integer)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The shopkeeper sold the article at four-fifth of the marked price

Loss incurred is 10/3%

**Concept used:**

Selling price = Cost price × (1 - loss percentage/100)

Profit = Selling price - Cost price

Percentage profit = (Profit/Cost price) × 100%

**Calculation:**

Let the marked price & cost price of the article be 145P & C respectively.

The selling price of the article = 145P × 4/5 = 116P

According to the question,

C × (1 - 10/300) = 116P

⇒ C × 29/30 = 116P

⇒ C = 120P

If sold at the marked price, then earned profit = (145P - 120P) = 25P

Then,

the percentage profit = (25P/120P) × 100% = 20.833% ≈ 21%

**∴ The profit percent, if he sold the article at the marked price is 21%.**

questions.question: Find the sum of all the possible values of (a + b), so that the number 4a067b is divisible by 11.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

**Concept used:**

The divisibility by 11 rule states that if the difference between the sum of the digits at the odd and even places equals 0 or divisible by 11, then the number is divisible by 11.

The Sum of any two digits is not more than 18.

**Calculation:**

Sum of the digits at the odd places = (4 + 0 + 7) = 11

Sum of the digits at the even places = (a + 6 + b) = (a + b + 6)

Let the difference be 11k where K is an integer.

So,

11 - (a + b + 6) = 11k 

Now, taking k = 0 we get,

11 - (a + b + 6) = 0

⇒ (a + b) = 5

Now, we're taking k = -1 since (a + b) can't be negative and more than 18,

11 - (a + b + 6) = -11

⇒ (a + b) = 16

Now, the sum of all the possible values of (a + b) = 5 + 16 = 21

**∴ The sum of all the possible values of (a + b), so that the number 4a067b is divisible by 11 is 21.**

questions.question: In a circle with centre O, AB is a chord of length 10 cm. Tangents at points A and B intersect outside the circle at P. If OP = 2 OA, then find the length (in cm) of AP.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The length of the chord AB is 10 cm.

Tangents at points A and B intersect outside the circle at P.

OP = 2 × OA

**Concept used:**

The tangent at any point of a circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact

By characteristics of a kite-shaped figure, the longer diagonal bisects the shorter diagonal.

In a 30-60-90 triangle, the ratio of the sides is always in the ratio of 1 : √3 : 2.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2139a7a671935cbbe76a1e18ff74abdf9da45f059158625380b04bfcd5ae82c.png] 

Let the radius of the circle be R cm.

So, OA = OB = R

Then, OP = 2 × OA = 2R

Tangent segments AP, BP, and radii OA, OB form a kite

So, OP bisects the chord AB.

Then, AQ = BQ = 5 cm

Now, ΔOAP & ΔOBP are two right-angled triangles.

From ΔOAP,

Cos ∠AOP = OA/OP

⇒ Cos ∠AOP = R/2R

⇒ Cos ∠AOP = 1/2

⇒ Cos ∠AOP = Cos 60°

⇒ ∠AOP = 60°

So, ∠OPA = 180° - (90 + 60)° = 30°

Also, ΔAQO & BQO are two right-angled triangles.

So, ∠OAQ = 180° - (90 + 60)° = 30°

From ΔAQO,

Cos ∠QAO = AQ/OA

⇒ Cos 30° = 5/OA

⇒ √3/2 = 5/OA 

⇒ OA = 10/√3

So, AP = (10/√3) × √3 = 10 cm

**∴ The length of AP is 10 cm.**

questions.question: Eighteen men can complete a work in 14 days. Three women do as much work as two men. Five men and six women started the work and continued for 4 days. Subsequently 3 more men joined the group. In how many total days was the work completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

18 men can complete the work in 14 days.

3 women do as much work as 2 men.

5 men & 6 women started the work and worked for 4 days after that 3 more men joined the group.

**Concept used:**

Work = Each unit done a day × No. of days taken to finish the work

**Calculation:**

Considering the LCM of 18, 27 & 14 as the total units of work.

LCM (18, 27, 14) = 378

So, the entire work = 378 units

Then, 18 men do each day = (378 ÷ 14) = 27 units work

Now, each man does = (27 ÷ 18) = 1.5 units work each day

So, each woman does = (2 × 1.5) ÷ 3 = 1 unit work each day

Now,

Five men and six women do in 4 days

⇒ (5 × 1.5 + 6 × 1) × 4 units work

⇒ 54 units work

After 4 days, remaining work = (378 - 54) = 324 units

After 4 days, number of men working = (5 + 3) = 8

Time taken to finish the work

⇒ 324 ÷ {(8 × 1.5) + (6 × 1)}

⇒ 18 days

Total time taken to finish the work = (18 + 4) = 22 days

**∴ In 22 days total days, the work was completed.**

⇒ 3 W = 2 M 

⇒ W/M = 2/3 Efficiency

⇒ Remaining work = 756 - 108 = 648 unit

3 more men joined the group

⇒ ((5 + 3)× 3 + 6 × 2) × Days = 648

⇒ Days = 648/36 = 18 days

Total days work complete in = 18 + 4 = 22 days.

∴ In 22 days total days, the work was completed.

questions.question: Trader A gives a single discount of 25% and Trader B gives two successive discounts of 20% and 5% on an identical item. If the discount given by A is Rs. 320 more than the discount given by B, then what is the marked price (in Rs.) of the item?
questions.solution:
Given:

Trader A gives a single discount of 25%.

Trader B gives two successive discounts of 20% & 5%.

The discount given by A is Rs. 320 more than the discount given by B.

Concept used:

Selling price = Marked price - Discount

Selling price = Marked price × (1 - Discount percentage/100) 

Calculation:

Let the marked price of the product be Rs. 1000P.

So,

The selling price of Trader A = 1000P - (1000P × 1/4) = 750P

Now,

The price of Trader B after first discount = 1000P - (1000P × 1/5) = 800P

The final selling price of Trader B after the final discount = 800P - (800P × 1/20) = 760P

According to the question,

760P - 750P = 320

⇒ 10P = 320

⇒ P = 32

⇒ 1000P = 32000

∴ The original marked price of the article is Rs. 32000. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Trader A gave 25% discount

Trader B gave two successive discount of 20% & 5% which is equal to (20 + 5 - 100/100) = 24%

According to the questions,

This difference of (25 - 24)% = 1% means Rs. 320.

So, 100% means Rs. 32000

∴ The original marked price of the article is Rs. 32000.

from ΔPQN,

⇒ (a + d)2 + b2 = 81 ....(1)

from ΔMQN,

a² + b² = 3²

from ΔMQR,

a² + (b + c)² = 7²
